who.value: buyer watching a TCG live auction

stage.value: transaction — a giveaway running during a live show

job.value: Get more giveaway entries by sharing the show with friends

arrivedFrom.value: Watching the show when the giveaway card appears

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The card 'Free random "Pikachu" vintage card · 56 entries · Your entries: 1' with 'Share to get more entries' explains the giveaway at a glance.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Share to get more entries' is an outlined button while the orange 'Bid: S$20' pill below draws the eye first.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Share to get more entries' and 'Terms & conditions' are clear, but 'Custom' next to the bid button doesn't say it sets a custom bid amount.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'entries' and 'Your entries: 1' are plain, and the share-for-entries rule is in the button label.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Sharing or not is a choice the viewer can make with what's shown.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The full rules sit behind 'Terms & conditions' and the card collapses with its chevron.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Giveaway, chat and bidding all belong to the live-show moment.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The entry counts and button label carry the giveaway without any paragraph.
